CFB.Settings.BridgeUrl.Name: Bridge URL
CFB.Settings.BridgeUrl.Hint: WebSocket endpoint of the Companion bridge Worker. Default: wss://bridge.companion-products.org/ws
CFB.Settings.ApiKey.Name: API Key
CFB.Settings.ApiKey.Hint: Shared secret. Must match the BRIDGE_API_KEY set on the Worker and the Companion (Supabase) secret. Stored ONLY in this browser (only the GM needs it).
CFB.Settings.InboundUrl.Name: Companion Inbound URL
CFB.Settings.InboundUrl.Hint: Endpoint of the Companion foundry-inbound edge function (Foundry→Companion direction).
CFB.Settings.InboundKey.Name: Companion Inbound Key
CFB.Settings.InboundKey.Hint: Secret sent as x-foundry-inbound-key. Must match the FOUNDRY_INBOUND_KEY secret on Supabase. Empty = Foundry→Companion sync disabled. Stored ONLY in this browser (only the GM needs it).
CFB.Settings.AutoConnect.Name: Auto-connect on startup
CFB.Settings.AutoConnect.Hint: Connect to the bridge automatically when the world loads (GM only).
CFB.Settings.Combate.Name: Hits and damage to the Companion
CFB.Settings.Combate.Hint: Sends the characters' attacks, rolled damage, damage taken and healing to the Companion, for the end-of-session report (only while a session is running there).
CFB.Settings.StatusMenu.Name: Connection Status
CFB.Settings.StatusMenu.Label: Open Status Panel
CFB.Settings.StatusMenu.Hint: View the bridge connection status, recent logs, and reconnect.
CFB.Status.Title: Companion Bridge — Status
CFB.Notify.NoApiKey: Companion bridge: no API key set. Configure it in the module settings.
CFB.Notify.ChavesMovidas: Companion bridge: the keys were moved out of the world settings (every player received them) into THIS browser. Another GM browser must enter them again in the module settings.
CFB.Notify.Substituido: Companion bridge: this connection was replaced by another GM window. Use "Reconnect" in the module status to take it back.
